physicalNotes: Radius 0.639 +/- 0.034 solar radii from Filomeno et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5734 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..90F/abstract): 444,552 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
